g.title: P1
g.text: Type F plug (mains input, 16 A class TBD)

g.title: X1
g.text: Type F socket output (16 A class TBD)

g.title: PS1
g.text: Pin 1/2 = AC, pin 3 = -Vo, pin 4 = +Vo. Keep AC pins and SELV output separated; fuse/MOV upstream. Datasheet isolation 2500 VAC is a claim; batch/hipot unverified.

g.title: J_5V
g.text: SELV 5 V distribution block (not a mains terminal)

g.title: J1
g.text: Carrier is SELV only. RELAY_IN1/IN2 are the same MOSFET drain net, exposed as two pins for the off-board relay module inputs.

g.title: W_RELAY_MODULE
g.text: To off-board 2-channel relay module. Keep in mains zone; do not route over SELV logic.

g.title: WUART_PZEM
g.text: PZEM side only; do not cross barrier.

g.title: CT1
g.text: Split CT connector (around one conductor only)

g.title: U6
g.text: Barrier: side 2 is PZEM isolated; side 1 is SELV.

g.title: K1
g.text: Two independent SPDT channels: CH1 switches L, CH2 switches N. NOT a mechanically linked DPST. IN1/IN2 are pulled LOW together by the carrier MOSFET; module active-LOW. Verify JD-VCC/pinout and rating.
